summary: Anthropic announced an expanded partnership with Cognizant to embed Claude across Cognizant's engineering platforms and enterprise client deployments, including agentic contract-review and underwriting tools.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement describes agentic systems replacing manual human tasks such as contract review and underwriting research.
mechanisms.quote: An agentic contract-intelligence system for a biopharmaceutical company that has helped cut contract review time by up to 40 percent while lifting extraction accuracy above 88 percent in that deployment.
